name: Pandu 0.3.0
body: Backup and restore, safer migrations, and update checks that never install silently. ## Highlights - `pandu backup` writes one archive of your database and settings - A failed migration restores its timestamped backup automatically - Release notes are sanitized before they reach the UI Read the [updating guide](https://github.com/ganddtn40/pandu/blob/main/docs/updating.md).
